messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing repeated Xid / 'GPU reset detected' patterns on 7 nodes in eu-west-1 over the last 2 hours. Need a consistent diagnostic bundle so oncall can triage quickly.

maria: can you paste an example dmesg snippet? also which fleet (g4/g5)?

alex: short snippet:
`[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3d:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus`
`[ 1234.568123] kernel: NVRM: GPU reset succeeded`
nodes are g5-type.

jon: +1 on a standard bundle. We should include: dmesg (last 10k lines), `journalctl -k -b --no-pager`, `nvidia-smi -q -x`, pod logs for pods on that node, `lspci -vvv` for PCI errors, and driver/sysctl state.

sam: propose small tar structure:
- metadata.json (node, hostname, timestamp, kernel, driver, pci_id, gpu_serial, pod_uids)
- dmesg.txt
- journalctl.txt
- nvidia-smi.xml
- pod-<uid>.log (up to 5MB each)
- nvlogs/ (if driver logs exist)

kevin: we should redact customer data. metadata.json should include container image names but strip env vars / secret mounts.

alex: snippet for quick collect (single command):
```
mkdir /tmp/gpu-bundle && cd /tmp/gpu-bundle
journalctl -k -b --no-pager > dmesg.txt
journalctl -u kubelet --no-pager > kubelet.journal.txt
nvidia-smi -q -x > nvidia-smi.xml
kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=$NODE -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.uid}{"\n"}{end}' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'kubectl logs --tail=500 -p {} > pod-{}.log || true'
tar czf /tmp/${NODE}-gpu-bundle.tgz . && upload-artifact /tmp/${NODE}-gpu-bundle.tgz s3://redwood-debug/bundles/
```

maria: can we add `nvidia-smi dmon -s u -d 1 -c 60` for a 60s sample while we repro? useful for thermal / power / util spikes.

jon: parsing heuristics to add to ingest: 
- regex Xid: `NVRM: Xid.*: (\\d+)`
- ECC keywords: "CE" "UE" "correctable" "uncorrectable"
- PCI errors: "PCIe Bus Error"
- map to categories: XID_79 (GPU off bus), ECC_UE, THERMAL, DRIVER_RESET

sam: ops-bot should tag bundle with correlation key: node:<node>, gpu_serial:<serial>, pci:<pci_id>, time:<ISO8601>

ops-bot: (automated) Received bundle 1955554321-0 from alex. Correlation keys: node:gpu-07, gpu_serial:GPU-1234ABCD, pci:0000:3d:00, timestamp:2026-03-18T12:45:21Z

kevin: runbook suggestion: if >3 Xid_79 within 24h on same GPU => drain node, cordon, schedule replace. If 1-2 Xid with ECC correctables => monitor + forced reboot if repeats.

maria: can infra add agent-side lightweight capture that uploads bundles to s3 automatically on first Xid occurrence? minimal CPU, tar rotation, scrub env.

alex: +1. but watch size; cap to 50MB and drop old bundles after 48h.

jon: I'll prototype a loghook plugin that listens for Xid/ECC patterns and triggers bundle creation plus a short JSON event to our incident queue.

sam: Punted tasks: 1) proto script, 2) S3 path + retention policy, 3) parsing mapping doc, 4) automation + RBAC (no customer secrets). Volunteers: jon(1), sam(2), maria(3), kevin(4).

alex: thanks. if someone can post a sample bundle link after upload I'll attach to incident-#987.

maria: :thumbsup:

kevin: also consider adding a short `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,clocks.gr,clocks.sm --format=csv` snapshot at failure time for quick dashboards.
